race.comment: Debutante IN ALL HONESTY (13) makes the most appeal in a mediocre affair. Has trialled six times dating back to April last year, and most recently took out a Moe jump-out. By Frankel and is a full-sister to the Group 2 winner Steinem. Certainly worth the gamble.  KLASYK MODE (14) was backed from $11.00 into $9.50 on debut last start over 1050m and after looking a chance on the bend weakened late to finish fourth. Awkwardly drawn but with the race experience on board she can play a key role against this lot. NOAH'S ARK (10) returns from an 11-week break for a second campaign. Was excellent on debut at Murray Bridge over this distance then faltered on a heavy track at the only other run. Should give a good account despite the wide alley. RED RIPPLES (11) has only placed once in ten but hasn't been far off them of late. Despite coming back sharply in trip cannot be ruled out. TOUCH OF FIRE (12) caught the eye on debut at Halidon recently. Each-way prospects.
